verdict.rationale: The evidence implies Workers serves HTTP (building APIs) and WebSockets (a pricing note on 'hibernating WebSockets'), so two of the four protocols appear on the same deployed service. Nothing shows inbound TCP or gRPC, and nothing shows the protocols working together without separate configuration. Missing for 10: inbound TCP serving, gRPC serving, evidence that all protocols run from one service with no per-protocol configuration, and in-depth first-party WebSocket docs or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve HTTP, TCP, gRPC, and WebSocket traffic from the same deployed service without separate protocol configuration
